patch.value: Release workflow would have failed on a padded crate version and a missing gate toolchain

The release job derives its tag from date with zero-padded month and day, then stamps that same string into Cargo.toml. Cargo rejects leading zeroes in numeric version fields, which was confirmed directly: a manifest carrying 2026.08.08 fails with invalid leading zero in minor version number. Separately the job runs just release-check while installing only just, so the gate would have failed on the pinned nightly toolchain, cargo-llvm-cov and cargo-audit before reaching the release steps. Neither could be caught by a passing local run because both live only in the workflow.

The git tag keeps its zero-padded date form while the crate version stamped into Cargo.toml strips the padding and preserves any disambiguating suffix, verified against Cargo for both plain and suffixed forms, and the release job installs the same toolchain and tools as the working continuous integration gate job so just release-check can run there at all.
